contea di ritrovamento: West Berkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN ARC[ADI-VS PF AVG] ; R/ [VIRTVS ROMANORVM]

A worn silver siliqua of Arcadius. Reece period: 21 [388-402]. Mint or issue place: Treveri (Trier, Germany). Obverse description: A diademed cuirassed & draped bust right. Obverse inscription: DN ARC[ADI-VS PF AVG]. Reverse description: Roma seated with a spear & holding out Victory. Reverse inscription: [VIRTVS ROMANORVM]
